parameters.content:
## Stripe payment to CRM, Slack and thank-you email

**What it does**
When Stripe confirms a payment, this marks the buyer as a customer in HubSpot, posts the sale in Slack and sends the buyer a short thank-you email with their receipt link.

**You need**
Stripe, HubSpot (private app token), Slack and Gmail credentials in n8n.

**Setup**
1. Connect the four credentials on the nodes that ask for them.
2. Pick your Slack channel in **Post the sale in Slack** and edit the email text in **Send thank-you email**.
3. Activate the workflow. n8n registers the Stripe webhook for you. Make a test payment in Stripe test mode.

Built by AI Strike Force, aistrikeforce.com
